diff --git a/python/ct/crypto/asn1/types_test.py b/python/ct/crypto/asn1/types_test.py
index 2631aa60..0fd2f1bc 100755
--- a/python/ct/crypto/asn1/types_test.py
+++ b/python/ct/crypto/asn1/types_test.py
@@ -786,18 +786,96 @@ class PrintTest(unittest.TestCase):
         # Currently all string types are just str, with no encoding.
         hello = "\x68\x65\x6c\x6c\x6f"
         opaque = "\xd7\xa9\xd7\x9c\xd7\x95\xd7\x9d"
-        string_types = [types.TeletexString, types.PrintableString,
-                        types.UniversalString, types.UTF8String,
-                        types.BMPString, types.IA5String]
+        unrestricted_string_types = [types.TeletexString, types.UniversalString,
+                                     types.UTF8String, types.BMPString]
+        restricted_string_types = [types.PrintableString, types.IA5String,
+                                   types.VisibleString]
 
-        for t in string_types:
+        for t in unrestricted_string_types + restricted_string_types:
             s = t(value=hello)
             self.assertTrue("hello" in str(s))
-            # TODO(ekasper): make this fail for PrintableString and possibly
-            # others according to their character set restrictions.
+
+        for t in unrestricted_string_types:
             s2 = t(value=opaque)
             self.assertTrue(opaque in str(s2))
 
+    def test_printable_string_constructor_rejects_invalid_characters(self):
+        valid = "AZaz09 '()+,-./:=?"
+        for invalid in ("abc*def", "abc@def", "abc#def",
+                        "long*invalid"):
+            self.assertRaises(error.ASN1Error, types.PrintableString,
+                              value=invalid)
+            self.assertRaises(error.ASN1Error, types.PrintableString,
+                              value=types.ASN1String(value=invalid))
+        s = types.PrintableString(value=valid)
+        self.assertTrue(valid in str(s))
+        converted = types.PrintableString(value=types.ASN1String(value=valid))
+        self.assertEqual(str(s), str(converted))
+
+    def test_printable_string_strict_decode_rejects_invalid_characters(self):
+        for invalid in ("abc*def", "abc@def", "abc#def",
+                        "long*invalid"):
+            self.assertRaises(error.ASN1Error, types.PrintableString,
+                              serialized_value=invalid, strict=True)
+
+    def test_ia5_string_constructor_rejects_non_ascii(self):
+        valid = "hello@example.com"
+        for invalid in ("abc\x80def",
+                        "\xd7\xa9\xd7\x9c\xd7\x95\xd7\x9d",
+                        "prefix\x80suffix"):
+            self.assertRaises(error.ASN1Error, types.IA5String, value=invalid)
+            self.assertRaises(error.ASN1Error, types.IA5String,
+                              value=types.ASN1String(value=invalid))
+        s = types.IA5String(value=valid)
+        self.assertTrue(valid in str(s))
+        converted = types.IA5String(value=types.ASN1String(value=valid))
+        self.assertEqual(str(s), str(converted))
+
+    def test_ia5_string_strict_decode_rejects_non_ascii(self):
+        for invalid in ("abc\x80def",
+                        "\xd7\xa9\xd7\x9c\xd7\x95\xd7\x9d",
+                        "prefix\x80suffix"):
+            self.assertRaises(error.ASN1Error, types.IA5String,
+                              serialized_value=invalid, strict=True)
+
+    def test_visible_string_constructor_rejects_control_del_and_non_ascii(self):
+        valid = " !~AZaz09"
+        for invalid in ("abc\x1fdef", "abc\x7fdef", "abc\x80def",
+                        "x\x00y", "prefix\x1fsuffix"):
+            self.assertRaises(error.ASN1Error, types.VisibleString,
+                              value=invalid)
+            self.assertRaises(error.ASN1Error, types.VisibleString,
+                              value=types.ASN1String(value=invalid))
+        s = types.VisibleString(value=valid)
+        self.assertTrue(valid in str(s))
+        converted = types.VisibleString(value=types.ASN1String(value=valid))
+        self.assertEqual(str(s), str(converted))
+
+    def test_visible_string_strict_decode_rejects_control_del_and_non_ascii(self):
+        for invalid in ("abc\x1fdef", "abc\x7fdef", "abc\x80def",
+                        "x\x00y", "prefix\x1fsuffix"):
+            self.assertRaises(error.ASN1Error, types.VisibleString,
+                              serialized_value=invalid, strict=True)
+
+    def test_restricted_strings_non_strict_decode_allows_legacy_invalid_content(self):
+        cases = [
+            (types.PrintableString, "abc*def"),
+            (types.PrintableString, "abc@def"),
+            (types.PrintableString, "abc#def"),
+            (types.PrintableString, "long*invalid"),
+            (types.IA5String, "abc\x80def"),
+            (types.IA5String, "\xd7\xa9\xd7\x9c\xd7\x95\xd7\x9d"),
+            (types.IA5String, "prefix\x80suffix"),
+            (types.VisibleString, "abc\x1fdef"),
+            (types.VisibleString, "abc\x7fdef"),
+            (types.VisibleString, "abc\x80def"),
+            (types.VisibleString, "x\x00y"),
+            (types.VisibleString, "prefix\x1fsuffix"),
+        ]
+        for string_type, invalid in cases:
+            s = string_type(serialized_value=invalid, strict=False)
+            self.assertTrue(invalid in str(s))
+
     def test_string_value_bitstring(self):
         # 0x1ae
         b = str(types.BitString(value="0110101110"))
diff --git a/mimo_test_command.sh b/mimo_test_command.sh
new file mode 100755
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mimo_test_command.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+set -uo pipefail
+cd /testbed
+
+
+dev-switch python3 3.12 2>/dev/null || true
+python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages -q pytest setuptools 2>/dev/null
+
+
+cd /testbed/python
+
+case "${1:-}" in
+  base)
+    python3 -c "
+import collections, collections.abc
+collections.MutableMapping = collections.abc.MutableMapping
+collections.MutableSequence = collections.abc.MutableSequence
+import pytest
+raise SystemExit(pytest.main(['-v', '-k', 'test_string_value_int or test_string_value_bool or test_string_value_bitstring or test_string_value_octetstring', 'ct/crypto/asn1/types_test.py']))
+"
+    ;;
+  new)
+    python3 -c "
+import collections, collections.abc
+collections.MutableMapping = collections.abc.MutableMapping
+collections.MutableSequence = collections.abc.MutableSequence
+import pytest
+raise SystemExit(pytest.main(['-v', '-k', 'test_string_value_string or test_printable_string_constructor_rejects_invalid_characters or test_printable_string_strict_decode_rejects_invalid_characters or test_ia5_string_constructor_rejects_non_ascii or test_ia5_string_strict_decode_rejects_non_ascii or test_visible_string_constructor_rejects_control_del_and_non_ascii or test_visible_string_strict_decode_rejects_control_del_and_non_ascii or test_restricted_strings_non_strict_decode_allows_legacy_invalid_content', 'ct/crypto/asn1/types_test.py']))
+"
+    ;;
+  *)
+    echo "usage: $0 base|new"
+    exit 2
+    ;;
+esac

rationale: Extend the three already-selected restricted-string constructor tests to reject each existing invalid value when wrapped in an unrestricted ASN1String, and compare a valid ASN1String conversion with direct valid construction for each restricted type. This exercises the string-like conversion contract without constraining the implementation. Existing direct construction, strict decoding, non-strict legacy decoding, unrestricted-string behavior and command selection remain unchanged.
